brief: ChurnLens：给独立开发者的流失分析 SaaS。功能：Stripe 同步开箱即用（实测接入 15 分钟）、周 cohort 视图、plain-English 流失报告（不用懂 SQL）。实测数据：接入 15 分钟，某用户第 2 周 idled-user 提醒找回 3 个流失前兆用户。
painpoints: Struggling with churn - users sign up, never come back after day 3. What am I doing wrong?
Is there a tool that turns Stripe invoices into a simple monthly P&L? Would pay for this
Anyone else hate configuring webhooks? Spent 5 hours debugging one today
